response.script: You already pour Del Maguey and Montelobos; Ilegal's Espadín Joven sits between them in taste and price. Mezcalería Tobalá ranks first of 25 for this brand's profile in Austin (affinity 0.84; ev-0001) and the room's core is 25-34 (demographic index 0.79; ev-0003). Take the Espadín Joven on a six-bottle trial and park it beside the Montelobos on the back bar; the smoky-sweet profile matches your 25-34 core. If it sits, we collect it.
